# Arhhal

> > Arhhal specializes in private, customizable Morocco tours led by local guides, offering personalized experiences across destinations from Marrakech to the Sahara Desert.

Arhhal is a Moroccan travel operator founded by Abdelilah Amrani that focuses on bespoke private tours rather than group experiences. The company emphasizes local expertise, cultural immersion, and sustainable travel practices across Morocco's diverse regions including the Sahara Desert, Berber communities, and coastal towns.
